Located in the Beach Haven Cottages at Dune Allen Beach, this 4-bedroom and 3-bathroom home has over 2100 square feet of living area and boasts natural views within a charming neighborhood. The home comes fully furnished to accommodate up to 12 guests and has a beautifully designed interior to help you feel at peace during your stay. If you're looking for the ultimate beach cottage feel that is authentic and does not compromise on comfort, the SEAS THE DAY home is the place for you.

A six-seater, street-legal golf cart is included with house rental. It's the perfect way to get around and enjoy the area with ease. Renters must be 25 or older and present a valid driver’s license.

THE SPACE: The entry level of this home has a cozy living area with two comfortable sofas and opens to the kitchen and dining areas. Through the kitchen, you have access to a full-sized washer/dryer to keep your garments clean, which means you can pack less and have more room for your shopping finds. You will also find a guest bedroom featuring a king bed and full bath, perfect for guests who may prefer not to take the stairs.

This home has a full kitchen, granite countertops, stainless appliances, and a large breakfast bar where you can cook your own meals. The dining area just off the kitchen has plentiful seating for 8 and additional seating for 4 at the bar. Both the kitchen and dining space are open to the living area, allowing your entire group to be together, whether dining or relaxing.

On the second floor are the spacious master suite with a king bed, a private bath with double sinks, a tiled Jacuzzi tub, a separate shower, and a balcony. This suite is perfect for enjoying downtime and the salty sea breeze. Two additional guest rooms are also available, one with a queen bed and a full bath and the other with two bunk beds, making it perfect for guests with kids. All bedrooms are equipped with a flat-screen TV for your leisure.

COMMUNITY: Beach Haven is a quiet residential community located on Scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach. It is a quick drive from Grayton Beach, Seaside, and Sandestin and less than an hour's drive from two commercial airports (33 miles to VPS, 38 miles to ECP). There are numerous nearby day attractions and site-seeing opportunities within a short drive to other popular communities such as Destin and Panama City Beach.


DINING and SHOPPING: With close proximity to local restaurants such as The Vue, Shunk Gulley, The Perfect Pig, Stinky's Fish Camp, and Sunrise Coffee, you can take advantage of the area's best-kept dining secrets. After enjoying your morning coffee or a nice meal, enjoy a leisurely walk or quick bike ride to check out various boutique shopping stores to get some local flair for yourself or your loved ones.

BEACH and OTHER AMENITIES: Lake Causeway Beach Access is less than a 2-minute walk to the south of the home. The neighborhood backs up to Oyster Lake, a coastal dune lake offering fishing and majestic views to the north. The seasonally heated community pool is just 4 houses to the west. The home offers an outdoor gas grill, outdoor shower, and covered back porch with seating.

PARKING: There is no covered parking but enough space to park 3 large vehicles or 4 small.

NO PHYSICAL CHECK-IN: Contact-less check-in. We provide an email prior to arrival with all the check-in instructions and key codes.

HOUSE RULES: You MUST be 25 years old or older to rent this property. This person is required to stay during the entire stay (NO exceptions and NO refunds). This house is pet-friendly for one small dog under 15 pounds - a non-refundable $150+tax fee.

WHAT WE PROVIDE:

Linens and Towels: Sheets and bath towels are included. Please bring your own beach towels.
Fully Equipped Kitchen: Includes cookware, utensils, and basic appliances. Bring your own spices and food.
Starter Supplies: We provide an initial supply of toilet paper, paper towels, garbage bags, laundry/dishwasher detergent, soaps, shampoo, and body wash. For longer stays, additional supplies may be needed.

WALTON COUNTY BEACH ACCESS: Key Points to Remember

Walton County offers more than 50 beach and bay access points, making it easy to enjoy the 26 miles of coastline. While you are welcome to traverse the wet sand along the entire shoreline, be mindful of private property. Below are five of the closest beach access options:

Lake Causeway Beach Access (directly across from the subdivision) – Ideal for quick visits and scenic walks but limited in space for extended stays.

Fort Panic Beach Access (0.7 miles west) – A county managed beach with a boardwalk, sea oats, and a spacious shoreline. Amenities include parking, bike racks, showers, and restrooms.

Topsail Hill Preserve State Park (2.6 miles west) – A stunning, unspoiled coastal preserve offering a peaceful and secluded beach experience. The park features over three miles of pristine white sandy beaches, towering dunes, rare coastal dune lakes, and scenic hiking trails but requires an entry fee. This is an excellent spot for nature lovers, offering opportunities for birdwatching, fishing, and exploring Florida’s unique ecosystems.

Dune Allen Beach (0.9 miles west) – A modest access point across from Stinky’s Fish Camp, featuring a newer restroom pavilion with multi-stall restrooms, outdoor showers, benches, and bike parking.

Ed Walline Beach (0.8 miles east) – A popular spot near Gulf Place, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, and other local favorites. Features a covered pavilion with picnic tables, grills, and a second-floor balcony for Gulf views.

For more details on all beach access points, visit the "Visit South Walton" website.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located on a lake, this vacation home is in Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Blue Mountain Beach and Grayton Beach State Park can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
